headline: The races finally sing
lede: Marble Madness got the one thing its cabinet never lets you forget: a continuous, virtuosic music bed under every race — composed for this build, and switching to a variation-up finale when the courses go strange.

notes.text: Two original A-minor showpiece beds (Marsyas idiom — relentless sixteenth-note runs, octave-pumping bass) now run from race 1, tighten tempo each race, and flip to an octave-higher finale for SILLY + ULTIMATE; big hits duck the bed, game over silences it.
The cabinet's actual tune is copyrighted, so the shelf law said no — what ships is the effect, not the melody, the same call Joust made about Rachmaninoff.

Harness grew 11 music gates plus a new browser driver: real race clears drive the tempo ladder, a death ducks but never silences the bed, and an analyser proves it's audible — 4 planted mutants each reddened exactly one gate.
Verify git show --stat after every commit: one commit this shift silently shipped only the harness after a mid-mutant checkout reverted the source; the baseline re-run caught it.
